senses.gloss: f. (denom. of נֵאוֹת, v. אוֹת I; cmp. נָאֶה) enjoyment, pleasure, benefit.
units: <cite ref="Taanit 8a:11">Taan. 8ᵃ</cite> <he>מאי ה׳ יש לך</he> what does it profit thee (to bite)?—

<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 5:2">Sifré Deut. 5</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="T00042"><he>רב</he></cite>, <cite ref="Deuteronomy 1:6">Deut. I, 6</cite>) <he>ה׳ גדולה וכ׳</he> your dwelling &c. was of great benefit to you; a. v. fr.—
Snh. 26ᵇ, a. fr. בעל ה׳ a worldling.—נדר ה׳ מן to vow refusal of any benefit or favor from a person.
<cite ref="Mishnah Nedarim 4:1">Ned. IV, 1</cite>, sq.; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Kiddushin 41a:1">Kidd. 41ᵃ</cite> <he>דור ה׳ ממנו</he> vow that you will have no favor at his hands. [Sifra B’har ch. III, Par. 3 <he>הניית</he>, v. <cite ref="E00253"><he>הוֹנָיָיה</he></cite>.]
